1. Add 1 to every value and take the log.
2. Blur the image with the Gaussian on the image mirrored at its edges, through the FFT of each row and column.
3. Subtract the log of the blurred image.
4. Stretch the result to 0 to 255 with Simplest Color Balance, clipping s1 and s2 percent.
5. With intensity, scale each pixel so that its intensity matches the result and its color ratios stay.
